# Expected changes in the Skyline Valley map expansion (Patch 52) on June 12, 2024

![Expected changes in the Skyline Valley map expansion (Patch 52) on June 12, 2024](/uploads/354_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[**Update June 12, 2024**] Track Rifle has other legendary perks

A lot of news awaits you in the **Skyline Valley Update (June 12, 2024)** with the **map expansion** in southern Appalachia in Shenandoah National Park. In this post you will find a summary of all the details you will encounter in Skyline Valley. This update is one of the largest updates to date, containing approximately 3x as many new files as most previous updates.

[Update June 9th, 2024] The Skyline Valley update has now been confirmed for June 12th, 2024 (source)

~~We currently don't have an official date for the update, due to the double score weekend on June 20th. and the necessary update before the next carnival event (to activate the changes) can currently be downloaded on June 25th. expect the update. As soon as the exact date is known, this post will be updated. (tbc = to be confirmed)~~

## New Skyline Valley area with new locations

The new Skyline Valley area begins south of the existing map in the mountains. You can go south from Dent & Sons Construction, Vault 96 or Johnson's Acre and end up in the new area. In these places on the edge of Skyline Valley you can already see the storm in the sky that is spreading across the entire Skyline Valley area.

You can set up your camp throughout the entire area, of course not in fixed locations, like on the rest of the map. This opens up many new possibilities. And you can also play with the weather. In your camp you can of course assume the Skyline Valley weather, but you can also e.g. a clear sky set up a weather control station.

Here you will now find a **map with all new locations** for your orientation in **Skyline Valley**.

*Tip: First go to observation towers and unlock surrounding locations.*

![Skyline Valley Map Expansion: All New Locations](/uploads/nukaknights-skyline-valley-map.jpg) 

## New Skyline Valley questline in Vault 63

The new Skyline Valley quest series includes 11 new quests that will familiarize you with Vault 63 and its inhabitants. There are numerous places to discover, interesting weapons and outfits as rewards, and secrets and abysses to explore.
